evals.name: wrap-sponsors-endpoint
evals.prompt: The Happily API just added a new endpoint, GET /api/public/{eventId}/sponsors. The response is { sponsors: Array<{ name: string; logo_url: string; tier: 'platinum' | 'gold' | 'silver' }> }. I want to wrap it the same way our other queries are wrapped and use it on the home page (app/(event)/page.tsx) to render a small sponsors strip below the hero. The sponsors strip should only render if the API actually returns sponsors — a failure to fetch shouldn't 404 the page. Show me the files I need to add or change.

evals.name: debug-silent-registration
evals.prompt: Users are reporting that the registration form on our event site is silently failing for some of them. The form submits, the page shows 'Submitted successfully', but the registration never shows up in the Happily dashboard. I'm not seeing any obvious errors in the server logs. Where would you start looking? Walk me through your debugging approach.

evals.name: pickup-new-api-field
evals.prompt: The Happily team just shipped a new field on the event payload: event.livestream.recording_url, which is a string URL pointing to the post-event recording. I want to render a 'Watch recording' link on the livestream page when that field is present. When I add `event.livestream.recording_url` to my JSX, TypeScript says the field doesn't exist. How do I fix this?
